<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Car insurer" processRef="claim-process" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="claim-process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="claim-lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>claim-start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>submit-claim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="notification" name="Notification department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>check-documents</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>register-claim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="handling" name="Handling department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>pick-up-claim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>check-insurance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>perform-assessment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>assessment-positive</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>phone-garage</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>schedule-payment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>reject-claim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>outcome-merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>send-letter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>process-complete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="claim-start" name="Claim submission started" />
    <bpmn:task id="submit-claim" name="Submit claim with relevant documentation" />
    <bpmn:task id="check-documents" name="Check documents for completeness" />
    <bpmn:task id="register-claim" name="Register claim" />
    <bpmn:task id="pick-up-claim" name="Pick up claim" />
    <bpmn:task id="check-insurance" name="Check insurance" />
    <bpmn:task id="perform-assessment" name="Perform assessment" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="assessment-positive" name="Assessment positive?" />
    <bpmn:task id="phone-garage" name="Phone garage to authorise repairs" />
    <bpmn:task id="schedule-payment" name="Schedule payment" />
    <bpmn:task id="reject-claim" name="Reject claim" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="outcome-merge" name="Outcome determined" />
    <bpmn:task id="send-letter" name="Send letter to customer" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="process-complete" name="Claim process complete" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="claim-start" targetRef="submit-claim" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="submit-claim" targetRef="check-documents" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="perform-assessment" targetRef="assessment-positive" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" name="positive" sourceRef="assessment-positive" targetRef="phone-garage" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="phone-garage" targetRef="schedule-payment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="schedule-payment" targetRef="outcome-merge" />
